name: @uicast/expr
description: The expression language of uicast documents: JavaScript expressions over JSON data. Closed AST allow-list, runtime membrane, CPU and allocation budget. Never calls new Function, so it needs no unsafe-eval.
author: Andrey Gubanov (https://github.com/finom)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!process.env.CI) throw new Error('Publish from CI: PACKAGE=<dir> npm run patch or minor tags a release, and the tag publishes it')" && npm run build
